review_target: Customer self-service booking wizard (/customer portal, BookingWizard) — five-step flow plus terminal screens

review_scope.interface: Customer booking wizard: five steps (dogs, services, date, time, confirm), the desktop summary sidebar, and the booked / deposit-held / waitlisted / request-sent / invalid-reschedule terminal screens
states: wizard shell empty, partial and full (rendered)
real DateSelection in its incomplete-availability degraded state (rendered)
summary sidebar empty, partial and full (rendered)
success screen and calendar open/full/closed legend (static reconstruction)
steps 1, 2, 4 and 5 including the commitment point (implementation and tests only, never rendered)
loading, empty, fetch-failure and server-refusal states (implementation and tests only)
review_scope.settled_scope_override_reason: The source context is current and complete for this surface but carries four open owner decisions (Q1 deposit disclosure, Q2 device priority, Q3 offline isolation, Q4 cancellation copy). None of them blocks the review: each recommendation is stated within the settled scope of the approved five-step structure, and the two decisions that bear on implementation (Q1, Q4) shape how recommendations 1 and 2 are built rather than whether they are warranted. Q2 is carried explicitly as a conditional on recommendation 5's priority rather than resolved by assumption, and no viewport is treated as primary.

states: BookingSummarySidebar at all three fill states
review_evidence_sources.exercised: Page load, accessibility-tree read, full-text extraction, computed-style and geometry probes on the two-column grid and the sidebar
limitations: Mounts static placeholders in place of steps 1, 2, 4 and 5
Runs inside the staff app shell rather than the customer portal shell
Establishes nothing about production routing, authentication, live data or end-to-end behaviour

states: same harness content at phone width
single-column collapse with the sidebar removed
review_evidence_sources.exercised: Viewport resize; computed-style probes; bounding-box measurement of all 38 calendar day and navigation buttons; WCAG contrast computation against resolved backgrounds; document horizontal-overflow check
limitations: Measurements are of the harness instance, not an authenticated production session
Screenshot capture failed because the browser pane stayed hidden, so no image evidence exists
Proves nothing about production, live data or end-to-end behaviour

states: DateSelection incomplete-availability (degraded) state, reached because all three availability RPCs returned 42501 permission denied to an unauthenticated caller
review_evidence_sources.exercised: Accessible-name extraction from 28 day buttons; data-state inspection; contrast measurement of open and closed day numerals; verification that the legend is withheld and the honest hint rendered
limitations: The complete availability state was never rendered, so open, full and closed were never seen together
The degradation cause is an unauthenticated caller, not a production outage
Establishes nothing about production, live data or real user behaviour

states: calendar open / fully booked / closed with legend
review_evidence_sources.exercised: Visual and structural inspection of hand-copied markup
limitations: Hand-maintained copies of markup that lives inline in BookingWizard.tsx, not the components themselves
Can drift from the real screens without any test failing, so treated as indicative of intended appearance only

material_gaps: No authenticated state of the wizard was rendered; steps 1, 2, 4 and 5 including the commitment point were assessed from implementation and passing component tests only
No real-world device evidence, so no viewport is treated as primary and recommendation 5's priority stays conditional
No assistive-technology testing: screen-reader output, keyboard order through the 28-day grid, and 200% zoom reflow were not exercised
The customer portal has no offline or sample-data mode, which is the direct cause of the three gaps above
Production salon_config values were not queried, so recommendation 2 is stated against the documented defaults

owner_decisions_required.topic: Cancellation-window copy at the commitment point
